name: RuleKB-GUI

rules.name: Text overlap
rules.definition: Two independent text runs are drawn over each other because of their positioning, so glyphs of one obscure the other. If one text spills out of its own box onto the other, report D6 instead.
visual_cues: two baselines inside one line box
illegible characters where two strings meet
rules.decision: intersection-over-smaller of two OCR boxes >= 0.15 and the boxes belong to different text runs

rules.name: Component or container overlap
rules.definition: Two components or containers overlap so that one covers part of the other (content, a control or its border), and the covering one is not a deliberate floating layer such as a modal, menu, toast or tooltip. Not D2: text that spills over its own box across a neighbour (D6); content cut away by an edge (D8).
visual_cues: a button or card cut by another box
rules.decision: two element boxes intersect with IoS >= 0.2, neither contains the other, and the covered one carries content, text or a control; or the screenshot shows one card, panel or control drawn over another

rules.name: Missing or undisplayed content
rules.definition: Content that should be shown is not: an image slot, list, card or section renders empty, as a uniform placeholder, a broken-image icon or a blank area where the layout expects content.
visual_cues: grey or white rectangle where an image is expected
alt text shown in an image frame
rules.decision: an image-shaped or content-shaped region is uniform (std < 6) where content is expected, or shows a broken-image glyph or a loading placeholder in a settled screen

rules.name: Null value
rules.definition: A field shows a programming placeholder instead of data.
rules.decision: OCR text matches the null-value pattern list

rules.name: Blurred or torn screen
rules.definition: Rendering corruption such as tearing, smearing, duplicated bands or a blurred region.
rules.decision: model judgement, supported when adjacent-row correlation drops below 0.3 along a band of >= 8 px

rules.name: Text overflow
rules.definition: Text is drawn beyond the boundary of its container or across neighbouring text or elements, with its glyphs still fully visible: it spills over instead of wrapping or being shortened. If part of the text is cut away at an edge, that is D8 (cropped content), not D6.
visual_cues: half characters at a box edge
text spilling out of a button or card
a label wider than its container
rules.decision: an OCR text box extends past its container or into an adjacent element while the glyphs at the boundary are intact
rules.source: UI-Lens 'Text Overflow'; 2026 multi-window GUI defect study

rules.name: Abnormal text ellipsis
rules.definition: Text is shortened with an ellipsis where the full text was meant to be visible (a title, a price, a button label), or the ellipsis itself is misplaced. Report D7 for such text even if it also looks cut or overflowing.
visual_cues: a number or price ending in an ellipsis
rules.decision: OCR text ends with an ellipsis while the containing element has free width (>= 15% of the text width) or the element is a button, title, price or amount

rules.name: Cropped content
rules.definition: Part of the content is cut away by its container or the screen edge and is not drawn at all: text with glyphs sliced at the edge, or an image, icon, card or control with a straight cut through it. A cut text is D8 (not D6).
visual_cues: an image or card with one side cut flat
an icon half outside its tile
a component touching the screen edge with content missing
rules.decision: glyphs or an image are sliced along a straight edge of the container or the screen, or an element box extends beyond its parent by >= 4 px with the part outside not drawn

rules.name: Text contrast
rules.definition: Contrast ratio between text and its background is below the level required for its size.
rules.decision: contrast < 4.5 for normal text, < 3.0 for large text (>= 18 pt or 14 pt bold)

rules.name: Non-text contrast
rules.definition: Boundaries of controls or graphical objects have contrast below 3:1 against adjacent colours.
rules.decision: contrast < 3.0 for a control boundary or an informative graphic

rules.name: Character visual angle
rules.definition: Character height subtends too small a visual angle at the viewing distance.
rules.decision: x-height visual angle < 16 arcmin (20 arcmin recommended) at the device viewing distance

rules.name: Touch target size
rules.definition: A touch target is smaller than the platform minimum.
rules.decision: target shorter than 44 pt (iOS) / 48 dp (Material) on a touch device, 24 CSS px minimum on any pointer (WCAG 2.5.8)

rules.name: Reflow at 320 px
rules.definition: Content requires two-dimensional scrolling or is clipped at a 320 CSS px wide viewport.
rules.decision: horizontal scroll width > 320 px or content clipped at the viewport edge

rules.name: Target spacing
rules.definition: Adjacent targets are too close to tap reliably.
rules.decision: edge-to-edge spacing of two interactive targets < 8 dp when either target is under 48 dp

rules.name: Colour vision
rules.definition: Information conveyed by colour alone is lost under deuteranopia or protanopia.
rules.decision: after Brettel simulation the distinguishing colour pair has deltaE00 < 11 and no secondary cue exists

rules.name: Ambient light contrast
rules.definition: Under 10,000 lx daylight the effective contrast of text falls below the readable level.
rules.decision: effective contrast after the glare model < 3.0 for body text

exemplars_note: Exemplars live under rulekb/exemplars/<rule_id>/ (2 positive, 2 negative each) and come only from S-Night and ErgoHMI, never from Test-Real.
